intro:
Something shiny is sparkling
on the ground near that Critter!
title: Fight or Flight
description: It looks like there’s a strong Critter guarding an item. Battling is the straightforward approach, but it looks strong. Perhaps you could steal the item, if you have the right Critter for the job.

1.label: Battle the Critter
1.selected:
You approach the
Critter without fear.
1.statBoost: The {{enemyPokemon}}’s latent strength boosted one of its stats!

2.label: Steal the Item
2.disabledTooltip: Your Critter need to know certain moves to choose this.
2.selected: .@d{32}.@d{32}.@d{32}$Your {{option2PrimaryName}} helps you out and uses {{option2PrimaryMove}}!$You nabbed the item!

3.label: Leave
3.selected:
You leave the strong Critter
with its prize and continue on.
